experiments.scope: Deterministic replay of one fixed public 128-byte message pair on the complete sha256-r31-prefix-v1 target, preceded once per isolated process by an exhaustive 131072-case round-trip and pinned-digest self-check of the proposed 32-byte tuple representation. The same pair is returned for every organizer trial; duplicate rows are expected and are not independent attack samples. Participant observations about the layout remain untrusted; the organizer independently checks only the collision event.
experiments.hypothesis: The two fixed messages are distinct and have identical full 256-bit digests under standard-IV SHA-256 with rounds 0 through 30, feed-forward, and FIPS padding on every block. Separately, every joint choice of the 17 free E bits for the pinned six-A fixture round-trips through the proposed 32-byte tuple representation and reproduces the committed layout digest.
